title: DECISION: message + attachments in single SQLite transaction
description: insert_message_with_attachments (crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs) inserts the message row and all attachment rows inside a single SQLite transaction, including the state counter advance. Alternative: separate insert calls with application-level cleanup on failure. Rejected because if the message INSERT succeeds and a subsequent attachment INSERT fails, the message exists in the DB with an incomplete attachment set — a client calling Message/get would see a message whose blobIds don't resolve. The single-transaction approach means either the full message+attachments commits or nothing does. The state counter is also advanced inside the transaction so a failed delivery does not consume a state version, keeping state tokens dense. Events are emitted after tx.commit(), not inside, so listeners never query a not-yet-committed row. Location: crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs insert_message_with_attachments.
